'''Kylo Ren's TIE whisper'''<ref name="TFF Press Event" /> was a modified [[TIE/wi interceptor]] utilised by the [[First Order]]'s [[Supreme Leader]], [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]], during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] against the [[Resistance]]. [[Gender|He]] used this [[Starship|ship]] to confront [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] on [[Pasaana]], where it was destroyed when the Jedi aspirant sliced off one of the wings with her lightsaber, though Ren survived the subsequent crash. After either having it rebuilt or replaced with an identical model, Ren flew it to [[Kef Bir]] after Rey traveled there to claim the [[wayfinder]]. Following a duel between Rey and Ren in the [[Death Star ruins|wreckage of the second Death Star]], Rey took the TIE Whisper, stranding Ren on the moon while she used it to return to [[Ahch-To]]. Planning to exile herself, Rey destroyed the TIE Whisper for a second time by burning it on the shores of Temple island.<ref name="Episode IX" />

==History==
[[File:TIEwhisper-TROS.png|thumb|left|250px|Kylo Ren in his TIE whisper on Pasaana]]
The TIE whisper entered service during the [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] between the First Order and the [[Resistance]], with one used by Ren, replacing [[Kylo Ren's TIE silencer|his]] [[TIE/vn space superiority fighter]]. Ren used his new TIE whisper to travel to [[Exegol]] where he confronted [[Darth Sidious]], who revealed the [[Sith Eternal]]'s fleet of [[Xyston-class Star Destroyer|''Xyston''-class Star Destroyers]], the [[Final Order]], and ordered him to kill [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] and end the Jedi. Ren later used his TIE to confront the [[Jedi]] Rey on the [[desert]] [[Planet|world]] [[Pasaana]], during which she jumped over his ship and sliced off one of its wings, causing it to crash. Ren flew another TIE of the same model to [[Kef Bir]], where he again confronted Rey in a lightsaber duel. Defeating and wounding him, Rey took the TIE and flew it to [[Ahch-To]], where she burned it, pledging that she would follow the path of [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and exile herself to the island. However, Skywalker's [[Force spirit]] confronted her and convinced her to continue the fight. Rey then took the wayfinder from the wreckage and departed the planet in [[Red Five (T-65B X-wing starfighter)|Luke's]] [[T-65B X-wing starfighter|old]] [[X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref>
